fees.additionalInfo: Payable each time a withdrawal is made from your account, where you arrange this over the counter from one of our branches. 40 free Branch transactions per month. If the minimum balance of your account for each day of a month (other than the month in which you open the account) is $50,000 or more, then you will receive 60 free transactions for that month.
fees.name: Withdrawal Fee

fees.additionalInfo: Payable when you request that we stop a cheque
fees.name: Stop Payment Fee

fees.additionalInfo: Payable when you use your Visa Debit card to perform a transaction overseas or where a merchant processes the payment overseas (whether or not the payment is in Australian dollars). It is calculated as a percentage of the total transaction amount and is debited to your account.
fees.name: Overseas Transaction Conversion Fee

fees.additionalInfo: Payable when we issue you a deposit book.
fees.name: Deposit Book Fee

fees.additionalInfo: Payable when you deposit more than $50 worth of coins with us. $5.00 per 10 minutes spent by us counting coins. Minimum charge of $5.00 applies.
fees.name: Excess Cash Deposit Fee

fees.additionalInfo: Payable each time you request a Newcastle Permanent cheque.
fees.name: Financial Institution Cheque

fees.additionalInfo: Payable when we debit an account at another financial institution at your request.
fees.name: Direct Debit Request Fee

fees.additionalInfo: Payable when we attempt to debit another account, but payment is dishonoured because there is not enough money to pay (the other account could be with us or another financial institution).
fees.name: Direct Debit Dishonour Fee

fees.additionalInfo: Applies to cash advances performed using the card via ATM, at a branch or other financial institution, or by internet banking.
fees.name: Visa Cash Advance Fee

fees.additionalInfo: Payable when you request a Certificate of Balance or Audit Certificate. $60/hour (min $10/copy).
fees.name: Certificate Fee

fees.additionalInfo: Payable each time any of the following transactions occur: a) a cheque you wrote is presented for payment; or b) a deposit is made by you or another person into your account over the counter at one of our branches; or c) a cheque is deposited by you or another person into your account; or d) you or another person transfers funds into your account from another NPBS account, where this was arranged over the counter at one of our branches or where we are asked to arrange this. 40 free Branch transactions per month.
